title: Fuel Can 3L Lockable – Reserve Tank for Motorcycles
descriptionHtml:
No more standing still with an empty tank

Running out of gas on the motorcycle is both stressful and can ruin the whole trip. A spare tank gives peace of mind when the nearest gas station is far away.

3 liters of reserve that can be locked

This slim fuel tank holds 3 liters and is lockable for better security. It's portable and easy to bring along on longer trips.

Features

  • Holds 3 liters
  • Lockable for better security
  • Slim and portable design
  • Antistatic container
  • Good reserve for motorcycles and longer trips

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
